description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the 'LogNode' interface and serves as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility. It allows for chaining log nodes to direct log output to multiple targets and provides a method to output logs with appropriate handling of message strings and exceptions.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging with chaining capabilities.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message to Android's log system, optionally appending a throwable's stack trace and forwarding the log to the next node in the chain.
